normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Casablanca By The Sea”, a spacious and inviting coastal retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach. This stunning 5 Bed, 5 Full Bath, 2 Half Bath home sleeps 13 and offers everything you need for an unforgettable 30A escape including 7 bikes, access to the iconic 12,000 sq ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool just steps away and community beach access easily reached by bike or seasonal tram. Thoughtfully designed with multiple En-suite bedrooms, generous living spaces across three levels and expansive outdoor balconies for gathering and entertaining, “Casablanca By The Sea” is perfect for families and groups looking to relax, explore and experience the very best of 30A all within walking distance of shops, dining, Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Sleeps 13 with 5 Bedrooms, 5 Full Baths + 2 Half Baths: Spacious En-suite bedrooms throughout provide comfort and privacy for families and larger groupsPrime Seacrest Beach Location: Walk to Peddler’s Pavilion, boutique shops, dining and live musicAccess to 12,000 Sq Ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool: Resort-style pool with waterfalls, loungers and a family-friendly splash area just steps awayCommunity Beach Access + Seasonal Tram: Easy, stress-free beach days with convenient tram service during peak seasons7 Bikes Included: Explore Seacrest, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and nearby 30A favorites with easeThird Floor Sitting Area with Kitchenette: Additional living space with mini fridge, coffee maker and blender plus access to a spacious balconyExpansive Outdoor Balcony with Grill: Perfect for sunset dinners, morning coffee and gathering under the coastal sky*** LIVING AREAS ***The main living space at “Casablanca By The Sea” is bright, open and designed for connection. Located on the 1st floor, the inviting layout brings everyone together whether you’re unwinding after a beach day or planning the next adventure. Comfortable seating and natural light create a warm atmosphere that feels like home from the moment you arrive.A separate sitting area on the 3rd floor offers additional space to relax, complete with a convenient kitchenette and direct access to the expansive balcony, giving your group room to spread out and enjoy multiple gathering areas.Spacious 1st-floor living area with ample seating and flat-screen TVOpen-concept flow connecting living, dining and kitchen spacesFront porch with seating for 4, perfect for morning coffee3rd-floor sitting area with kitchenette and balcony access*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The chef’s kitchen is well equipped and thoughtfully laid out, making it easy to prepare meals while staying connected with family and friends. From casual breakfasts before biking to the beach to shared dinners after sunset, this space is designed to bring everyone together.Chef’s kitchen with stainless steel appliances and generous counter spaceBar seating for 3 ideal for quick bites or conversationDining area with seating for 8 for family meals and game nights*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***“Casablanca By The Sea” offers multiple outdoor spaces designed for enjoying Florida’s sunshine and warm coastal breezes. Grill dinner on the expansive 3rd-floor balcony, gather around the outdoor dining table or relax with lounge seating as the sun sets over Seacrest.Expansive 3rd-floor balcony with gas grillAl fresco dining for 6 plus lounge seatingPrivate balconies off select bedroomsFront porch seating for relaxed mornings and evening wind-downs*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With 5 bedrooms and 5 full baths plus 2 half baths, “Casablanca By The Sea” is designed to comfortably accommodate up to 13 guests while offering privacy and relaxation for everyone.1st FloorQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerHalf Bath: Conveniently located off the kitchen2nd FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, twin daybed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboBunk Room: 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboLaundry Room: Full-size washer and dryer3rd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerHalf Bath: Located off the sitting area*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, “Casablanca By The Sea” places you steps from some of 30A’s most beloved destinations while offering access to resort-style community amenities.12,000 Sq Ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool: Just steps away with loungers, waterfalls and a family-friendly splash areaSeasonal Tram to the Beach: A convenient and breezy ride for easy beach daysCommunity Beach Access: Easy access by bike or tramPeddler’s Pavilion: 5-minute stroll to shops, dining, bike rentals and live musicRosemary Beach: 8-minute walk to cobblestone streets, boutique shopping and coastal diningAlys Beach: 8-minute walk to white architecture, upscale dining and serene courtyards*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and coastal living.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
